method: Direct canonical Japanese-source authoring in both Chinese locales and complete own-pair self-review of every string. No other-pair reads, cross-review or external translation service.
coverage: Every title, full explanatory/example paragraph, application prompt, key term and illustration alt in collectTranslatableUnits.
semanticChecks: Access-network installation and cable arrival do not establish service activation; indoor/outdoor and aerial/underground conditions remain separate.
Optical and metal cables preserve light/electric signal distinction without narrowing all metal conductors to copper.
Sheath state, outer diameter, internal construction, communication capacity and transmission tests remain separate.
Cable closures retain product-dependent use and branching/pass-through distinction; no color mapping invented.
Pole existence does not authorize added loads; clearance height is site and facility dependent.
Duct mouth visibility does not establish entire-path clearance; manhole/handhole names do not authorize entry.
Telecom tunnels and shared utility ducts preserve management boundaries; C・C・BOX identity and non-universal U-shape limits retained.
Cover depth is not centerline/invert depth; plan/profile levels, intermediate drainage and design-specific requirements retained.
Separation distances do not assume centerline or outside reference; parallel horizontal and crossing vertical dimensions remain separate.
Owner agreement for one segment is not approval for all crossings.
Mandrel passage only establishes specified-tool passage in identified bores; airtightness, pressure drop and verdict scope remain separate.
No test diameter, duration, pressure, legal cover-depth threshold or universal acceptance criterion invented.
